findings.issue: Actual drag route calls select(source), copy, select(target), then pasteClipboard. These publish selection/clipboard changes before paste performs newContradiction. Checking only operations.paste rejection or the controller state at paste entry misses violation of the promised pre-action atomicity. The plan requires atomic rejection but does not explicitly identify this existing multi-publication route or define its before snapshot.
findings.requested_change: Specify preparing drag candidate and clipboard/provenance effects without publishing, then shared analysis, then a single successful commit. Snapshot state before dropNode (not pasteClipboard) and on rejected drag compare module, original selection, original clipboard/copies, accepted state, generation/draft identity and interaction/focus policy. Exercise move and copy drags through the controller, including typed partial mismatch and out-of-scope reference with unrelated holes.

additional_observations.issue: Observed manifest input_root differs from requested root. Four exact reviewed hashes are recorded; approvals must be aggregated against the same frozen bytes after reconciliation.

Monotone finite constraints are feasible at bounded width/node limits, but finite graph bounds alone do not bound arbitrary redundant pending-equation creation. Use canonical deduplicated constraints/worklist and only enqueue changed facts; explicit termination/work bound and stress/permutation evidence are necessary. This overlaps the known Terra bound finding rather than adding a separate veto.

Existing nodeId:message set comparison cannot distinguish a new violation at another operand with identical parent diagnostic text, and cloned IDs create the converse false positive. Structured violation identity and adversarial same-parent left/right replacement, same-text nominal mismatch changes, copy/move/remap and unchanged prior-invalid tests should resolve the known Terra finding.

assessment: All 23 structural output sorts and independent operand/root constraints are covered; partial exact/width/endpoints and equality/concat/join equations avoid invented schemas. Exact complete checker projection and 46-case parity remain required. Scope/ownership must be established before propagation so cyclic or shared graphs cannot be legitimized by inferred facts.
